thesis: The episode examines the pandemic's impact on real estate, noting a historic drop in home supply due to sellers waiting out the crisis and buyer nervousness. It argues that the ability to work from home is shifting supply and demand curves by allowing high-income workers to move from expensive areas like the San Francisco Bay Area to cheaper locations, which could significantly alter home prices and market dynamics.
